title: Tools Module
summary: This module defines the base classes and utilities for creating and managing tools that agents can use to interact with the world, including input parsing, execution, and error handling.

nodes.label: BaseTool
nodes.title: BaseTool Class
nodes.description: The foundational class for all LangChain tools, providing a standardized interface for tool definition, input validation, execution, and error handling.

nodes.label: Tool Schema Conversion
nodes.title: Tool Schema Conversion
nodes.description: Infers and generates Pydantic schemas for tool arguments, ensuring proper type validation and structure for tool inputs.

nodes.label: Retriever Tool Functionality
nodes.title: Retriever Tool Functionality
nodes.description: Provides asynchronous functions for retriever-based tools, enabling them to fetch and format documents based on a query.

nodes.label: Legacy Tool Imports
nodes.title: Legacy Tool Imports
nodes.description: Handles backward-compatible imports for tools from older LangChain versions, redirecting to `langchain-community` for modern usage.

nodes.label: Runnables
nodes.title: Runnables Module
nodes.description: Provides the core `Runnable` interface, which `BaseTool` extends to enable chaining and composition of operations.

nodes.label: Callbacks and Tracing
nodes.title: Callbacks and Tracing Module
nodes.description: Manages callback mechanisms and tracing for monitoring and debugging tool execution.

nodes.label: Data Handling
nodes.title: Data Handling Module
nodes.description: Provides utilities for document loading and formatting, used by retriever tools to process search results.

groups.label: Tool Definition & Core Logic
groups.title: Tool Definition and Core Logic
groups.description: Encapsulates the fundamental structure and operational logic for all tools within the system.

groups.label: Tool Execution Support
groups.title: Tool Execution Support
groups.description: Components that facilitate the execution and integration of tools, including asynchronous operations and legacy compatibility.
